content_policy.description: The app is fully offline and ships only content that may be redistributed inside it. There is no Quran Foundation content, no runtime Content API access, no OAuth2/token-broker path and no English translation in this bundle. Only Tanzil text and (once rights-cleared) recitation audio and transliteration are eligible.

distribution_policy.deny_reason: QuranicAudio.com permits personal use only and forbids commercial use; Ezber must not ship QuranicAudio-backed recordings.
